meta.source: DESIGN.md v3 + frozen demo (Reference/cocky-monk-demo.html — demo wins on conflict)
meta.rule: Edit this file only. Regenerate: node Tools/tokens-build.mjs · Gate: node Tools/tokens-build.mjs --check

palette._note: player = the 8 identities as VALUES rather than hues. Every one clears 3:1 on the backdrop AND 4.5:1 against the black initial drawn inside it, which puts a hard floor under how dark the ramp can go; the eight are then ORDERED to maximise the weakest adjacent pair (2.10:1, found exhaustively over all 8! orderings — a naive light/dark zigzag scored 1.24). Eight greys are not eight hues: at pawn size they are genuinely hard to tell apart, which is why the initial is drawn INSIDE the token and the name always accompanies it. DESIGN.md §9 asked for identity that survives without hue; monochrome forces the issue rather than allowing it.

semantic._note: The layer every consumer names. Nothing here is named after a colour, which is what let the whole system go monochrome by editing the palette alone. `accent.truth` is now the BRIGHTEST value in the app rather than a green: in greyscale, contrast is the only way to say "this one is real". Since the light inversion there are TWO secondaries: `secondary` is dark, for the white page; `secondaryOnSurface` is light, for quiet text inside a dark card. One value could not serve both without going invisible on one of them.

board._note: The functional layout, unchanged between themes (DESIGN-DIRECTION.md §7).

timer._note: The bar BRIGHTENS as it empties, and thickens with it. In a monochrome system value is the only channel colour used to have, so it has to do the work colour did — and the thickness means it is still never value alone (DESIGN.md §9).

bgLayers._note: Two near-invisible white washes and a dot grid, at roughly a sixth of their original alpha. DESIGN-DIRECTION.md §6: remove decoration before adding it, and keep the background quiet enough that a screenshot stays readable. Hex8 = RRGGBBAA; literal rather than palette refs because they carry alpha.

themes._note: Themes may override BACKGROUND LAYERS ONLY (DESIGN.md §3). Rules code never branches on theme. Values lifted from the frozen demo theme-* CSS.

display.license: OFL, bundled — license row in ASSETS.md before the file enters the project

body.note: System font, Dynamic Type throughout — never bundled (DESIGN.md §2 Type)

cardWord.note: The hero. Scale toward 52 pt, slightly tight tracking (demo .word)

eyebrow.note: Section labels like 'ORDET ER' — quiet structure without headers

press.note: Mechanical press (DESIGN.md §2): button carries a colored under-shadow; on press it translates 4 pt down and the shadow compresses to 1 pt (demo .btn:active). Never soft material shadows.

durations._reducedMotion: Reduced Motion (DESIGN.md §9): hops → slides, pops/bobs → crossfades, nose growth → crossfade to final length, drifting stars → static. Demo disables all animation/transition under prefers-reduced-motion.

springs._format: Apple SwiftUI springs: .spring(duration:bounce:). CSS approximation emitted by the generator: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1 + 1.5×bounce, 0.64, 1) — matches the frozen demo beziers (bounce 0.40 → (.34,1.6,.64,1) pop; 0.37 → (.34,1.56,.64,1) nose; 0.27 → (.34,1.4,.64,1) pawn).
springs._reducedMotion: Every spring here has a Reduced Motion fallback: crossfade (pops, bobs, nose) or linear slide (pawn hops). Loops (bobIdle, goalPulse, gmStealPulse tint) become static.

buttonPress.note: Mechanical press: translateY 4pt down, shadow 5→1pt (demo .btn transition .08s)

chipFlip.note: Tick-in chip flips rotateX 360° to 'klar ✓' with a snap + .light haptic (demo .pchip transition .3s)

optionStagger.note: Vote options stagger in ~70 ms apart, rising 10 pt (demo .stagger rise .4s, animation-delay i*70ms)

revealPop.note: Newest reveal card pops: scale .85→1 with −1.5° un-rotate (demo @keyframes pop, .5s cubic-bezier(.34,1.6,.64,1))

noseGrow.note: One springy notch per vote collected, rising boing pitch per notch (demo .nose width .5s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1))

pawnHop.note: One space per hop, interpolatingSpring ~0.35 s/hop + .soft haptic + theme hop sound (DESIGN §5); demo: .3s cubic-bezier(.34,1.4,.64,1) on a 330 ms cadence. Compresses under the 20 s board cap

truthReveal.note: Dim → truth card settles scale 1.06→1.0, truthGreen glow + shadow, confetti, .success haptic (DESIGN §7)

gmStealPulse.note: Screen tint pulses gmViolet + sting + .heavy haptic; chuckle ≤ 0.8 s (DESIGN §5/§7; demo sting ≈0.65 s)

bobIdle.note: Waiting face bobs gently ±7 pt with −1°/+1.5° tilt, 2.4 s loop (demo .bob)

goalPulse.note: Goal space pulses a slow gold ring, 2 s, until claimed — all themes inherit (demo @keyframes goalglow)

tallyPop.note: Vote tally dot lands with a soft pop (DESIGN §7 'anonymous dots land per option with soft pops')

sound.rules: All audio ducks under, never over, the room. One-shots ≤ 1.5 s. CC0/OFL only, logged in Resources/Audio/CREDITS.md + ASSETS.md. UI triggers events by NAME only (LANES.md seam 4); lane C promotes files from AssetsIncoming/ into Resources/Audio/. 'TODO:original' = no Kenney match yet, needs an original recording.

_grammarNotes.cardShuffle: DESIGN §7: vote opens = card-shuffle.ogg on every device
_grammarNotes.pawnHop: Salongen wooden tap default; Fjellet boot crunch + Verdensrommet thruster pop have no Kenney match (DESIGN §3 hop sounds)
_grammarNotes.noseBoing: Rising boing pitch per nose notch — demo synthesizes it; needs an original one-shot
_grammarNotes.gmSting: Violet sting for GM steal / new-GM fanfare tail; chuckle tasteful, ≤ 0.8 s
